title: FEN Community Pack
description: A small quality of Life pack to play on my community servers Network. It includes shaders, optimizers and a voicechat to play along everyone on the Network!
body:
# **Welcome**!

This is a quality of life pack to play along on my Community Server :)

It has only some small basic shaders, their graphics optimizer, inventory tweaks and a voicechat included!

With this you can enhance your gameplay either in a singleplayer world or on our Network of servers!

We currently have only 2 servers hosted, but this will be expanded more over time.


To join the network and play along with everyone, join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/fen)!
If you have any problems, please contact me [@Kurtchen](https://discord.com/users/239461951170674690)
